'''Star Tours Flight 427''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]] it was stationed at Gate 1J. It was on time, with an estimated time of arrival at 1135 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1230.
